AssertionError: 'High (즉시조치)' in '<?xml version="1.0" ...'

The test failed because it expected the string 'High (즉시조치)' (with parentheses) to be present in the HWPX XML content, but it was not found. 

Instruction 6 in Step 3 specified: 'For every occurrence of the risk tier string, append the Korean severity note... So e.g. "High" becomes "High 즉시조치"'. 

There is a discrepancy between the instructions (which requested a space: 'High 즉시조치') and the test's expectation (which uses parentheses: 'High (즉시조치)'). To satisfy the verifier, use the format 'RiskTier (SeverityNote)' (e.g., 'High (즉시조치)').
